diagnostics_ref: prontopc-diagnostics output (os, disk[], memory, temp_files, recycle_bin, browser_caches, windows_caches, update_leftovers, startup_programs, drivers, device_errors, bsod_history, smart_health, network, dns_cache, security)

plan_bounds.estimated_mb_recovered_cap: Each action's estimated_mb_recovered is clamped to [0, measured cap from its mb.source]. The plan total may never exceed the sum of measured reclaimable space in the diagnostics.

clear_temp_files.notes: diag.temp_files is an ARRAY of {size_mb}; the Orchestrator sums size_mb for the cap. Repair.cs: DeleteRecursive(TEMP, C:\Windows\Temp).

clear_all_browser_caches.notes: diag.browser_caches is an ARRAY of {browser,size_mb,file_count}; cap = sum of size_mb. Subsumes the five per-browser actions (see plan_bounds.subsumption).

clear_chrome_cache.notes: browser_caches is an array; the current predicate_ops cannot match a single browser element, so this is gated on any browser cache present and its per-browser mb is not bounded (it is subsumed by clear_all_browser_caches, which is preferred). Clearing an absent browser is a harmless 0-byte no-op in Repair.cs.

clear_edge_cache.notes: See clear_chrome_cache: subsumed; per-element match not expressible in v0.1 predicate_ops.

clear_windows_caches.notes: Thumbcache/iconcache/prefetch; not pre-measured in diagnostics, so estimated_mb_recovered forced to 0.

empty_recycle_bin.notes: Engine reports done, not a freed byte count; mb estimate comes from diagnostics.

clean_windows_update_cache.notes: Field name verified in buildDiagnosticText. Stops/starts wuauserv+bits around SoftwareDistribution\Download purge; services are restored, so no reboot.

clean_component_store.notes: DISM StartComponentCleanup — safe periodic maintenance; amount not pre-measured (matches system-prompt guidance).

remove_windows_old.notes: Repair.cs RemoveWindowsOld() SKIPS when C:\Windows.old is absent — the precondition mirrors that exactly. Often the single largest reclaim.

optimize_visual_effects.notes: In Repair.RestartActions. Gate to memory-pressured machines where it helps.

sfc_scan.notes: In Repair.RestartActions. Gate to corruption indicators, not healthy machines.

dism_restore.notes: In Repair.RestartActions. Companion to sfc_scan for image corruption.

chkdsk_scan.notes: chkdsk C: /scan is online (NOT in RestartActions). diag.smart_health is an ARRAY whose per-drive 'healthy' leaf is not yet confirmed, so this is gated on crash/device-error indicators; TIGHTEN to a SMART-warning predicate once the smart_health leaf schema is confirmed.

reset_network_stack.notes: In Repair.RestartActions. Gate to an actual connectivity failure.

reset_windows_update.notes: In Repair.RestartActions. Renames SoftwareDistribution/catroot2 — gated to a large stuck update cache (>1 GB), not routine cleanup. Add a windows_update failure predicate if the diagnostics expose one.

target_name.source: must match a name in diagnostics.startup_programs

disable_startup_item.notes: Repair.DisableStartupItem errors without target_name; hive defaults HKCU. Missing/invalid params => drop the action.

driver_report.notes: Report-only ('noted'); the engine takes no destructive action.

hardware_report.notes: Report-only ('noted'). May recommend physical service. Add a smart_health-unhealthy predicate once that array's leaf schema is confirmed.
